subject: Shell content slot, route factory, usePenSurface registration
body:
# Contract S03 -> S12a: shell content slot and pen-surface registration

Please reply with a `decision` (accept or amend). I am building the shell against this now.

## 1. Route tree (`apps/web/src/router.tsx`, owned by S03)

- `rootRoute` (skip link + `<Outlet/>`), public children: `/sign-in`, `/auth/callback`, `/system`.
- `appRoute` (pathless layout id `app`, `beforeLoad` redirects to `/sign-in?redirect=<path>` when signed out) renders `<AppShell>`; protected children: `/` (Today), `/settings/account`.
- **Your route:** export a factory from your own file, e.g. `apps/web/src/ink/routes.tsx`:
  `export function inkLabRoute(parent: AnyRoute) { return createRoute({ getParentRoute: () => parent, path: "/ink-lab", component: InkLab }) }`
  and add ONE line to the `appRoute.addChildren([...])` list in `router.tsx` (claim `apps/web/src/router.tsx` for that one line; I will keep the list one-route-per-line so the merge is trivial). A dev/lab route is **not** added to the nav: nav items are data-driven from `/api/nav` (server defaults) and only list product features; nothing for ink until a product surface exists (S12b/13).

## 2. Content slot (what `<AppShell>` gives the page)

- `<main id="main" tabIndex={-1} data-shell-content>` wraps the route `<Outlet/>`; max width 1320 px with the gutter; it is the skip-link target.
- The shell sets **no** `touch-action`, no pointer/touch/gesture listeners and no `user-select: none` on the content slot or its ancestors. Nav pill (≥ 640 px, top) and tab bar (< 640 px, bottom, fixed) live **outside** `<main>`, so a surface never sits under a shell listener.
- Insets the shell exposes on `<html>` as CSS custom properties (px, include safe-area): `--shell-top` (height of the nav pill area, 0 on phone), `--shell-bottom` (tab bar height + safe-area, 0 on tablet/laptop). Use them to position an ink toolbar or a full-bleed surface without overlapping the chrome.
- Full-bleed surfaces: put `data-bleed` on your root element to opt out of the max-width only (the shell CSS handles `[data-shell-content] > [data-bleed]`).

## 3. Pen-surface registration (`apps/web/src/shell/chrome.tsx`, owned by S03)

```ts
// While a pen surface has the pen tool active the shell must not steal gestures and should keep
// chrome out of the way. Register once per mounted surface; the hook cleans up on unmount.
export function usePenSurface(active: boolean): void
// Read side (shell + later segments): true while any registered surface has an active pen tool.
export function usePenActive(): boolean
```

- Effect: while `usePenActive()` is true the phone tab bar collapses (translates out, stays in the DOM and accessible via keyboard focus which brings it back) and `<html data-pen-active>` is set so your CSS can scope `touch-action: none` to the active surface. Nothing else changes.
- Ref-counted, so several surfaces on one page are fine. Works outside the shell (no provider required: the hook is a no-op store subscription when the shell is absent, e.g. on `/system` or in your lab tests).
- Keyboard: the shell reserves Cmd/Ctrl+K for search (not bound until segment 07) and binds nothing else; your tool shortcuts are yours, but please ignore events with `metaKey`/`ctrlKey` + K.

If you need anything else (e.g. a top-bar slot for the ink toolbar), say so in an amendment.
